text: Coffee with Lena this morning. Her son starts reception on 3rd of September and she's already dreading the uniform shopping. She's gone fully vegan since the summer, so no more cheese boards for her. Need to send her that lentil ragu recipe.
Oisín's housewarming is Saturday 14 June. He finally got the keys to the flat in Phibsborough. His girlfriend Tamar is coeliac so I'll bring something gluten free.

Bao and Anika are hosting a dinner sometime next week, date tbc. Anika's been off alcohol since January and Bao's into natural wine now, apparently. Ask what I can bring. Bao also said his nephew Thanh is starting at the international school after half term and barely speaks English yet, so Anika's been teaching him phrases over dinner. Sweet. Their cat Pho sat on my lap the whole evening.

Long call with Siobhan. Her daughter Ava graduates from Galway on 21 November, first in the family to finish uni. Siobhan's thrilled but stressing about the hotel. Ava wants a decent pair of headphones, Siobhan said, if I'm stuck for a present. Must get a card in the post by mid November.
Blessing said the christening party got called off, her mum's not well enough to travel. They're doing a small thing at home instead end of the month.
Zainab's twins sit their 11 plus on 14/09. She says Yusuf is fine but Maryam is properly nervous, not sleeping. Text Zainab the night before.
Quick catch-up with Aisha after yoga. She can't do dairy at all, it's not a preference. Good to know before the Christmas dinner.
Santiago invited me to his 40th, early March, somewhere in Shoreditch. Wife Magda is organising it as a surprise so keep quiet. He only drinks mezcal these days, could get him a nice bottle.
Ben's leaving do is Friday 3rd of October at the Crown. He's off to Leeds for a new job.
Rang Jonah back. His boy Reza got his GCSE results, two 9s and the rest 8s. Jonah sounded so proud. Should drop round with something for Reza this weekend.

Jamal and Mateo's anniversary dinner on 12 May, they've booked the tasting menu at that place on the canal. Mateo's allergic to shellfish, Jamal hates coriander, so the chef's been briefed. I'm going, need a gift.
Gintaras is doing the big barbecue again over the summer, probably July. His dog Bruno nearly ate the sausages last year. He's teetotal now, says he feels loads better.
Note to self: book the restaurant for my birthday, 19 April. Somewhere with good veggie options for Claire.
Tomás's daughter had her first day at secondary yesterday. He said she came home buzzing. Ask him how week one went on Friday.
Ali rang about the dinner party at his on the 8th of November. Bringing dessert. He mentioned his partner Sara is going low carb, so maybe a cheese plate instead of the tiramisu.
Vanessa. Pescatarian, loves Rioja, can't stand mushrooms. Her husband Xavier the opposite, eats anything.

Eamon's mum turns 80 on 27 June and the family are throwing a lunch at the golf club. He's a bit overwhelmed with the planning, his sister Chantal isn't pulling her weight. Check in with him sometime next week. He also mentioned his own lad Tomás just got into the sixth form he wanted, so at least there's some good news in that house. Mum's diabetic, so the cake needs thought.
Delroy had his graduation yesterday, finally done with the nursing degree. Send congrats and maybe a bottle of the Jamaican rum he likes.

Thomas and Rahul are hosting the neighbours' Diwali party on 1st of November. Rahul cooks everything from scratch, no shop-bought. Thomas is in charge of drinks. I'm bringing the mithai. Their daughter Esther is doing her first Bharatanatyam performance at the party, she's been practising every evening since early October and is apparently terrified. Rahul's mum is flying in for it on the 28th.
Esther's in bits about her son's driving test on 30/10, more than he is honestly. Third attempt. Wish him luck through her the day before.
Pick up oat milk and the gluten free flour.
Lena's little one, Mia, lost her first tooth, very excited about the tooth fairy.
Chat with Anika at the school gate. Her eldest sits her mock exams early December and is struggling with maths. Anika asked if I knew a tutor. Must send her Claire's number.

Dinner at Bao's was lovely. He made pho from scratch, takes him two days. Found out Anika's sister Lin is moving to Vancouver end of the year. Bao's mum is visiting from Hanoi in early March, he's already cleaning.
Magda's hen do is 7th of June, Lisbon. Her best friend Siobhan is running it. Magda doesn't drink so it's going to be a spa and food weekend. I need to pay the deposit by the end of the month.
Oisín said Tamar's been offered a place on the masters at Trinity starting September. She's nervous about going back to study at 34. Oisín's taking her out for dinner Friday to celebrate.
Ava. Siobhan's girl. Nut allergy, carries an EpiPen. Remember for the graduation lunch.
Blessing got the job at the hospital. Starts 2 December. She's been on agency shifts for two years so this is massive. Flowers?
Saw Zainab in Tesco. She said the twins both passed, Maryam got into the grammar and Yusuf's going to the comp with his mates, which he wanted anyway. Congratulate Maryam next time I see her.
Aisha's having a few people round for Eid dinner, she invited me and Ben. Ben's a fussy eater, will only eat chicken basically. Aisha laughed and said she'll make plain rice for him.

Party at Santiago's was brilliant. Met his brother Mateo for the first time, he's a chef in Madrid, spends summers here. Magda said they're trying for a second baby. Santiago wants to do a paella night sometime in the spring. Mateo's not keen on spicy food, which is funny for a chef. Also met their neighbour Delroy Walsh, retired teacher, grows his own chillies and gave me a jar. Should send Santiago a thank you text tomorrow.
Jonah's wife Tamar, different Tamar, is recovering from her knee op. He's doing all the school runs. I should offer to take the kids one afternoon next week.
Reza's eighteenth on the 5th of August. Jonah's hiring a hall. Reza's big into vinyl, apparently wants a turntable.
Mum's coming down 14th to 16th of February. Book a table somewhere quiet for Saturday.

Jamal mentioned his nephew Kofi is graduating from Edinburgh in early July. The whole family is flying up. Jamal's stuck on what to get him. I suggested a good fountain pen. Kofi's been sending Jamal photos of the Edinburgh flat all year and he's apparently a keen climber too, so maybe a voucher for the climbing wall. Jamal's flying up on the 3rd and back on the 7th of July, so it needs ordering by end of June.
Mateo is doing dry January again, and veganuary on top this year. Masochist. He's hosting a 'sober supper club' 25/01, invited the whole team.
Gintaras's daughter, Ieva, starts nursery 6 January. He's more nervous than she is. Gintaras's wife is back at work the same week, so it's a big month for them. Text him on the 6th.

Lunch with Tomás and Ali. Tomás has given up red meat for his cholesterol, doctor's orders. Ali's training for the Dublin marathon on 26 October, eats pasta every night. Ali's girlfriend thinks he's mad. Tomás said his son Jonah has his first parents' evening at the new school on the 15th and Tomás is bracing himself, the teacher has already emailed twice. Ali and I are doing the Sunday roast at mine on 9 November, Tomás is bringing his kids. Need to get a big chicken.
Sara's birthday dinner got cancelled, she's got covid. She's rescheduling for sometime the week after next. Send her a get well text tonight.
Vanessa's daughter Lucía had her ballet exam on Saturday. Vanessa didn't say how it went, find out.
Xavier and Vanessa invited me to their Bonfire Night party, 5th of November. Bring sparklers and a bottle of red, Vanessa only drinks red.
Eamon called. The party for his mum's 80th went great, all twelve grandkids showed. Chantal turned up last minute with a cake. He sounded relieved.
Dropping Delroy's housewarming present off on Thursday. He's in the new place in Peckham since 1 September.

Chantal's struggling a bit. Divorce came through end of last month and she's moving out of the family home over the summer. Kids are 9 and 12. The youngest, Ali, starts secondary in September and is worried about not knowing anyone. She said she just wants a quiet Christmas this year. I need to call her more, maybe every couple of weeks, and invite her for Sunday lunch soon. She's vegetarian, don't forget.
Thomas mentioned Rahul's parents are coming over from Pune for the whole of December. They're both strict vegetarians, no eggs either. Thomas is a bit stressed about hosting for a month.
Rahul's sister Priya got engaged last weekend! Wedding is planned for 2nd of February next year in Jaipur. Rahul's already looking at flights.
Esther's son passed his test!! Fourth time lucky. She says he wants a car now. Send her a congrats message for him.

Claire's son starts at Cambridge on 4th October, studying medicine. She's dropping him off and then going straight to a spa to cry. Claire says he lives on Pot Noodles. Maybe a cookbook as a going-away present.
Need to RSVP to Lena's 50th by Friday. It's 22 March at the Ivy, black tie. Must get my suit dry cleaned.
Siobhan's husband Eamon, the other Eamon, is gluten free and only drinks cider. Everyone calls him Ozzy. Noting this before their party on 10th of January.
Bao said his daughter got her first school report and it was glowing. He forwarded it to half the family.
Anika and Bao split up. The dinner they were hosting in December is off. Anika's staying in the house with the kids for now. Check in with her this week, gently.
Blessing's little girl Ava, she goes by Avi, turns 5 on 18/03. Party at the soft play. Avi is obsessed with dinosaurs, anything dinosaur. I'm taking Mia.
Grocery run Saturday for the dinner party. Lamb, pomegranate, the good feta.
Called Aisha about her dad. Hip replacement went ahead on Tuesday, he's home now but grumpy. She's taking two weeks off to look after him. Pop round with soup at the weekend.

Zainab, Jamal and I finally agreed on a date for the uni reunion: sometime in late May, probably the bank holiday. Jamal's doing the booking. Zainab's halal and Jamal's vegetarian so somewhere Indian probably. Remind Zainab to check with Reza Usman whether he can come up from Bristol.
Santiago is hosting the World Cup final watch party, if Spain make it. His cat Churro hates crowds, so it'll be in the garden.
Jonah texted. Reza's results are 14 August and he's anxious, needs AAB for Manchester. Jonah's trying not to make it worse. Message Reza on results morning.
Magda said Santiago's been signed off work for stress for a few weeks. She's worried. Their son's starting primary the same week. I could take him for a pint over the weekend.

Ben's partner Gintaras, yes another Gintaras, is doing a cookery course in Florence over the summer, three weeks in July. Ben is jealous. Ben's birthday is on the 2nd of August while Gint's away, so I should organise something for Ben that week.
